evidence.quote: This study aimed to assess the effectiveness of anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody and hetrombopag for relapsed/refractory immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) following glucocorticoid treatment.

mentioned_categories.value: anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody and TPO receptor agonist drugs

pixel_observations: Four timelines titled Case 1 to Case 4 each run left to right in two rows with a blue arrow.
Diagnosis ITP and Relapse and pSS labels are in red text.
Platelet values are printed as PLT numbers; some are printed as "PLT <1", "PLT <10", "PLT 200-300", "PLT 130-143" and "PLT Normal".
No faces, identifiers or personal names are printed on the figure.

caption_claims.value: Caption states this is the clinical course of the patients and defines the abbreviations ITP, GC, rhTPO, PLT, Eltrom, TCM, IVIG, U, Hetrom, Avatrom, NSAIDs, RTX, SRL, RPT, pSS, TAC, HCQ and that the PLT unit is ×10^(9)/L.

clinical_significance.statement: The authors present this as the clinical course of the patients.

limitations: Case 1 shows "PLT <1" where the text reports a platelet count below 10 after eltrombopag discontinuation; the printed figure label reads "PLT <1" and the text value is recorded separately.
The Case 1 label after the NSAID reads "PLT 2" whereas the text reports a count of 20 after diclofenac; both are recorded as printed or stated.
Case 3 shows a later RTX 600/100/100mg course not described in the text.
Case 2 shows RPT (ripertamab) labels whereas Table 1 lists rituximab for Case 2.

visual.general_description: Four line plots with small triangle markers titled Case 1 to Case 4, each showing platelet count (PLT, x10^9/L on the y axis) against Date on the x axis, with one red triangle on each plot.
visual.detailed_description: Case 1: y axis 0 to 400 with ticks every 50; x tick labels 2022/5/31, 2022/11/30, 2023/5/30, 2023/11/30, 2024/5/30, 2024/11/30, 2025/5/30. Many closely spaced low points early, a sharp peak above 350 soon after, fluctuating 30 to 150 later, then a long segment to a final point near 245 at the right end; the red triangle sits at a low value near the 2023/5/30 tick. Case 2: y axis 0 to 800 with ticks every 100; x tick labels 2023/1/1, 2023/1/31, 2023/3/2, 2023/4/1. Values stay near zero from January to late March, with the red triangle at a low value just before a steep rise to a peak above 800 and a final lower point near 650. Case 3: y axis 0 to 250 with ticks every 50; x tick labels 2023/2/1, 2023/2/22, 2023/3/15, 2023/4/5, 2023/4/26, 2023/5/17. Low values early with the red triangle at a low value near the 2023/2/22 tick, then a rise to about 155, a dip near 65, a peak near 235, a fall to about 130 and a final point near 150. Case 4: y axis 0 to 150 with ticks every 50; x tick labels 2024/4/15, 2024/7/15, 2024/10/15, 2025/1/15, 2025/4/15, 2025/7/15. Low values then several oscillations between about 5 and 145 around July 2024, the red triangle at a low value near 28, a peak near 146, a long line down to about 117 and later final points near 14 to 25. Point values are not printed on the plots; the values above are visual estimates from the axes.
